== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Starsweep Tower serves as the primary headquarters for the [[Skysworn]]. It is located at the center of [[Stormrock]], a massive floating city built upon a green cloudbank. As the most prominent structure in the city, the tower rises above all other buildings and features a high-altitude docking area where ships can land. The interior of the tower contains various specialized facilities and numerous meeting rooms that are used by the [[Skysworn]] for a wide range of activities, including administrative tasks, interrogations, and social gatherings. The tower also provides living quarters for members of the organization, with room quality varying based on whether an individual is a trainee or a full [[Skysworn]]. The facility is exclusive to the [[Skysworn]] and their trainees.}}
